keyRecommendations.text: RAMRIS, introduced in 2002, scores synovitis, bone erosion, and bone-marrow oedema or osteitis.
The updated score also evaluates joint-space narrowing and tenosynovitis.
Synovitis and bone-marrow oedema are scored 0 to 3 and erosions 0 to 10. Tenosynovitis is scored 0 to 3 from the maximum width of effusion or enhancement.

clinicalBottomLine: Use RAMRIS for synovitis, erosions, and bone-marrow oedema, and the updated score when tenosynovitis and joint-space narrowing are also being graded. The scales are 0–3, 0–10, and a width-based 0–3 for tenosynovitis.
notableCaveats: The review says RAMRIS is time-consuming and needs experience for reproducibility.
